summary.intent: Continue GSD phase-planning for cipher-box phase 70.1 (rotation read-plane durability and deep crash-resume soundness): validate researcher findings against CONTEXT.md, resolve an open scope question, and prepare to move into planning.
summary.outcome: Decided to expand scope to include the Rust rotation-engine twin (engine.rs), recorded the decision as locked decisions D-11–D-13 (plus adopted D-07 plane recommendation) in 70.1-CONTEXT.md, and committed the update; next step is to have the researcher deepen engine.rs grounding before drafting the plan.

repo: There is no durable-store seam wired into the rotation engine's core walk in cipher-box; RotationHighWater/enforceResolved is only used at the client.ts read gate, so the D-01 ECIES checkpoint requires inventing a new injectable callback seam mirroring the existing grantCallbacks/persistCallback pattern.

crates/sdk/src/rotation/engine.rs is a full Rust twin of the TS rotation engine (used by desktop FUSE/WinFsp) and shares the same depth-1-only consumption bug, but is structurally further behind (missing recursive verify_subtree_clean, missing-root-as-dirty handling).

The per-rootNodeId job checkpoint deliberately documents 'never key material' as a boundary — the wrapped-key checkpoint for D-01 should fold into the per-nodeId high-water plane instead, per the adopted D-07 recommendation.

code.finding: Rust twin of the TS rotation engine; was outside CONTEXT.md's stated file scope (which only listed floor_store.rs + rotation/high_water.rs) until scope was explicitly expanded to include it.

workflow: CONTEXT.md's decision-coverage gate forces any subsequent plan to explicitly address locked decisions (D-01 through D-13 etc.), so scope changes discovered mid-research get written back into CONTEXT.md before planning proceeds.
AskUserQuestion was used to force an explicit human call on a genuine scope fork (fix TS engine only vs. fix both engines) rather than the assistant deciding unilaterally.

friction: CONTEXT.md undercounted call sites for SC#5: actual is 6 call sites across 5 methods, omitting deleteItem/deleteToBin and mislabeling line :2276 as 'upload' when it's actually createFolder.

No existing durable-store callback seam exists for the rotation engine's core walk, meaning D-01 can't reuse an existing pattern and requires new plumbing through performScopeExitRotation's 6 call sites.
open_items: Deepen the researcher's grounding on engine.rs (Rust twin) before planning continues.
Design and thread a new injectable checkpoint callback seam (mirroring grantCallbacks/persistCallback) through performScopeExitRotation's 6 call sites for the D-01 ECIES checkpoint.
Bring the Rust engine up to structural parity (recursive verify_subtree_clean, missing-root-as-dirty) and add its own crash-resume coverage for SC#6.
Check RESEARCH.md's Validation Architecture section structure to inform VALIDATION.md (was in progress when transcript ends).
